EDITING EXPERIENCE

Great editing is about knowing what to keep, what to cut, and how to make it all feel.

I’m Emmanuel Agbo, a video editor and YouTube channel manager with over four years of experience, and the founder of Webar Media. I turn raw, long-form recordings into engaging podcast episodes, high-retention trailers, and scroll-stopping short-form content.

Whether I’m cutting a multicam podcast, designing kinetic typography for vertical reels, or managing YouTube SEO and packaging, my focus is viewer retention and visual storytelling.

I build structured, reliable post-production workflows that help creators, podcasters, and brands scale their video output without the stress of editing.
